question: Select the most of appropriate synonym of the word: **Wane**
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Decline .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Wane"** means to decrease in size, extent, or degree, or to diminish gradually.
 
• Among the given options, the most appropriate synonym for "Wane" is **"Decline."**
 
• **Option Analysis:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** Grow — Incorrect, as it means to increase or develop, which is opposite to "Wane."
 
• **Option 2:** Intensify — Incorrect, as it means to strengthen or make more severe, which does not align with the meaning of "Wane."
 
• **Option 3:** Decline — Correct, as it aligns with the meaning of "Wane" (gradual decrease).
 
• **Option 4:** Increase — Incorrect, as it is opposite to the meaning of "Wane."
 
 

Correct sentence: *The synonym of "Wane" is **Decline**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Antonyms of Wane:**
 
 
• Grow
 
• Intensify
 
• Increase
 
 
 
• **Other Synonyms of Wane:**
 
 
• Diminish
 
• Fade
 
• Subside
